title: Catalyst Unknown
description: this mod adds ingredients to mix with and get a random effect till you put it in your journal and save it (still in early development so the journal doesn't work at all)
body:
# About

this mod adds ingredients to mix with and get a random effect till you add it to your journal and save it, there is 8 ingredients in the mod(currently):
1. redstone
2. glowstone dust
3. spider eye
4. fermented spider eye
5. sugar
6. gunpoder
7. rabbit foot
8. ghast tear

mix 2 of those with each other to get the effects

# HOW TO USE
you put one of the ingredients on your main-hand, and another one in the offhand, and then Shift and right click to use the ingredients.

# Commands(currently)
/cujournal (summary)
/cujournal effects
/cujournal combos

# WARNING
**This mod is currently in early alpha and under active development.
You may encounter bugs, crashes, or incomplete features, and the number of available ingredients is still limited.

If you run into any issues or have ideas, feel free to report them to help improve the mod.
**
